name: Guess where
summary: A world map game on a travel post: the poster drops clues one at a time, friends drag a pin where they think the poster is, and the reveal drops a star, draws a line from every pin and crowns the closest.
useWhen: yo whats up just having fun in south america eating tostadas
bet nobody can guess what city im in rn
new place who can guess it, hint: the bus had a goat
make them guess where i went for break
dontUseWhen: the post already names the exact place and nobody is guessing
planning a trip before it happens (use trip-draft)
asking for recommendations in a city (use try-this-here)

author.description: Who posted and is hiding where they are

line.description: The post's own line, shown in quotes under the title

clues.description: 2 to 5 clues in the order the poster drops them, a few words each

shown.description: How many clues are already out, at least 1

place.description: The real place, shown at the reveal, e.g. 'Cusco, Peru'

lat.description: Latitude of the real place (the map runs from 80 north to 60 south)

guesses.description: Friends who already guessed: where their pin is and what they said with it
